qa_pairs.question: What torque value should be used for the ASS 300J type selector lever?
What section of the manual covers external shift linkage specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 24-15 Automatic Transmission, subsection 24 51 External shift linkage.

qa_pairs.question: What component is designated as 1AZ in the external shift linkage section?
How many different torque specifications are listed for the selector lever on transmission?
qa_pairs.answer: Two specifications: 10 Nm for All types and 15 Nm for ASS 300J type.
